preconditions.description: The number of tasks is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of prerequisite pairs is between 1 and 100,000.
Each prerequisite pair contains exactly two elements.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= pair[0] < N and 0 <= pair[1] < N for pair in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Each task in a prerequisite pair is a valid task index within the range [0, N-1].

preconditions.expression: all(pair[0] != pair[1] for pair in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: No task is a prerequisite for itself.

preconditions.expression: all(pair[1] != pair[0] for pair in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: No directed cycle exists in the prerequisite graph.

postconditions.description: The function returns a boolean indicating whether it is possible to finish all tasks.
